data.one_liner: Fast and customizable animated mesh gradients for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Renders free-form mesh gradients using shaders and vertices, allowing developers to create unique visual effects and backgrounds. It supports custom point positions, colors, bezier control points, and animations.
use_when: You want to create custom animated mesh gradient backgrounds or UI elements.
You need complex free-form gradients that go beyond linear or radial shapes.
avoid_when: You are targeting devices or performance limits where high tessellation mesh rendering causes frame drops.
You only need simple linear or radial gradients built into Flutter.
strengths: High customizability with vertex-based mesh and bezier control points.
Uses shaders and vertices for performance.
weaknesses: Complex mesh animations can be performance-heavy if tessellation factors are set too high.
Historically had rendering engine compatibility challenges (though fixed in recent versions).
